messages:
carmen: quick notewe need a single-sheet solution brief that sales can hand to security/compliance teams after the webinar. combine deploy-mode decisioning, SLA bullets, and a short security checklist.
nate: agreed. prefer a top summary (1 sentence value prop), 3 boxes: Deploy Modes, Security & Controls, SLA & Benchmarks. each box 3 bullets + micro-cta.
olivia: security box: customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM), audit logs + SIEM integrations, data residency controls, encryption at rest/in transit. keep language cautious until legal signs off.
pranav: SLA box: targeted SLOs per deployment mode, failover behaviour, and response windows for incidents. include a short "when to pick Dedicated vs Private" decision line.
carmen: benchmark callout: "conservative estimate: 95th percentile latency under 100ms on Dedicated for 4k-8k context; ~0.5 USD / 1k tokens for a typical assistant workload" -> engineering to confirm. label as provisional.
nate: marketing ops: please ensure any download creates an inbound lead with tag `enterprise_solution_sheet` and populates fields: account_size, compliance_requirements, requested_feature. route logic below.
ops-bot: suggested routing pseudocode:
```
if lead.tag == "enterprise_solution_sheet":
  if lead.account_size >= 500000:
    route -> prod_enterprise_AE
  elif lead.compliance == true:
    route -> solutions_engineer_queue
  else:
    route -> growth_sales_pool
```
olivia: also add a 1-line ROI for finance buyers about predictable cost and lower ops burden vs self-hosting. keep conservative numbers.
pranav: sales play: add 3 qualifying q's (data residency needs, peak qps, compliance auditors) and 2 common objections + responses. AEs should have a 30s talk track.
carmen: webinar followup plan: email with one-sheet PDF, link to recording, and a short form that auto-tags leads. timeline: draft ready by Tue, final assets by Fri for next week's webinar.
nate: engineering to provide benchmark numbers by Mon EOD. legal to review compliance bullets after draft.
olivia: i'll draft security checklist and send to legal.
pranav: small ask: include a micro-diagram showing routing + failover (dedicated -> hosted fallback). helps ops folks.
carmen: thanks. once draft is live i'll post in #marketing and tag AE leads. let's keep this <1 page.
ops-bot: doc created: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Example-enterprise-sheet-draft (marketing,sales) :white_check_mark:
carmen: perfect. will ping once design mock is in Figma. :rocket:
